*Another night of late night studying! It wasn't even finals you were studying for! Just another shit test you had to study all day and night for. You briskly and tiredly walk towards your dorm room, keeping your pace on the sidewalk. The only light to guide your way comes from the headlights of passing cars of late night partiers and the streetlights endlessly illuminating up and down the streets. It was calm, you enjoyed these nightly walks following the brutal and agony filled studying for hours and hours. Reaching into your pockets, you pull out your earbuds and your phone. Placing your earbuds snugly into your ears and turning on Spotify, you lazily turn on your playlist and crank up the audio.*

Paralyzed in fear you stand there under a streetlamp, thinking to yourself: "Dear god.. I'm going to die here! Or I'm going to get robbed or.. or worse! I'll be raped by some sick perverted woman in a monkey costume!" A figure pops out of the bushes. Some short looking Latina woman in her 40's. She wasn't dressed like some Hispanic housewife or any woman over the age of 20, mind you. She dressed like some of the girls around college or like a stereotypical bimbo from the 2000's. Oh well, she's got a nice body for an aged woman such as herself.*
